newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Oct supermarket sales down 0.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Chile Oct supermarket sales down 0.4 percent.

text.p: Chilean supermarket sales fell 0.4 percent in October compared with the same month last year, said the Association of Chilean Supermarkets (Asach).
The figures bring the rise in supermarket sales in the first 10 months of the year to 6.7 percent, said Asach.
Non-perishable good sales rose 7.5 percent in October, with meat sales up 2.4 percent and sales of other perishable products rising 1.5 percent on a year ago.

Supermarket sales are used as a rough barometer of consumer spending. Chileans are among Latin America's most enthusiastic supermarket shoppers, with over 90 percent of Santiago's domestic shopping carried out in supermarkets.
